## What is DeliWer?

DeliWer is Dubai's all-in-one move-in concierge and relocation platform, operating since 2023.
We coordinate every service a new Dubai resident needs when arriving or leaving — all via WhatsApp.
No complicated forms. No agencies. Fast, reliable, and covering every Dubai area.

DeliWer is NOT a real estate agency. We do NOT list properties for sale. We coordinate the
administrative and logistical process after you've secured a home — plus we operate Flex Living,
a marketplace for flexible monthly rooms in Dubai (no annual contract required).

DeliWer also operates ChainTrack, a B2B logistics and electronics supply vertical serving freight
brokers, cargo importers, and electronics buyers across the CIS region and beyond.

Contact: WhatsApp +971 52 394 6311 | info@deliwer.com | https://www.deliwer.com

---

## Core Services

### 1. Ejari Registration (mandatory Dubai tenancy contract registration)
- Ejari is legally required for all Dubai rental contracts
- Must be registered through RERA-authorized Trustee Centers
- DeliWer coordinates the full process on your behalf
- Required documents: signed tenancy contract, Emirates ID (tenant + landlord), title deed
- Government fee: AED 220 | DeliWer service fee: see concierge-pricing
- Processing time: 1–3 business days (often same-day)
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/ejari-dubai

### 2. DEWA Activation (Dubai Electricity & Water Authority)
- Connects electricity and water for new Dubai apartments
- Requires valid Ejari certificate
- Takes 1–3 business days after document submission
- DeliWer handles the full application and follows up on your behalf
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/dewa-activation

### 3. Move-In Concierge
- Bundles: Ejari + DEWA + movers + cleaning + internet + water filtration
- One WhatsApp contact coordinates all vendors
- Covers all Dubai areas: JVC, Marina, Business Bay, Downtown, Deira, Al Barsha, and 40+ more
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/move-in-plan

### 4. Move-Out Concierge
- Ejari cancellation, final deep cleaning, utility disconnection, keys handover coordination
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/move-out-package

### 5. Flex Living — Monthly Rooms Dubai (No Annual Contract)
- Room types available: private rooms, shared villa rooms, partition rooms, studios, bed spaces
- Prices from AED 550/month
- No annual contract — month-to-month tenancy
- Available in: Dubai Marina, JVC, Al Barsha, Deira, International City, Jumeirah, Mirdif,
  Al Furjan, Business Bay, Downtown Dubai, JLT, Karama, Silicon Oasis, Al Quoz, and more
- Tenants: browse listings, use the budget quiz, WhatsApp to enquire
- Hosts/managers: submit available rooms via the website or WhatsApp
- Brokers: earn AED 150–800 per confirmed placement, 30-day attribution
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/flex-living

### 6. Dubai Business Setup
- Free Zone company formation: DAFZA, Dubai South, Commercity, and others
- Mainland trade license
- UAE Golden Visa assistance
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/business-setup

### 7. AquaCafe — Water Delivery & Filtration
- Premium water delivery and shower/drinking water filtration systems
- Subscription and one-time supply available
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/aquacafe

### 8. Emergency Exit Plan (UAE)
- Free emergency exit plan for Dubai/UAE residents
- Covers: emergency contacts, financial escape routes, exit procedures, family safety protocol
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/emergency-exit

## ChainTrack — B2B Logistics & Electronics Supply (by DeliWer)

ChainTrack is DeliWer's B2B vertical for freight logistics and electronics supply. It is strictly
separate from DeliWer's consumer home-services. ChainTrack serves cargo brokers, freight
forwarders, electronics importers, and CIS-market buyers.

### 9. ChainTrack Logistics — Dubai–Gawadar Corridor
- Air cargo and charter freight between Dubai World Central (DWC) and Gawadar Port (CPEC Free Zone)
- Hormuz-free routing: Dubai → Gawadar → INSTC onward rail/road
- Service: cargo intake, charter coordination, CPEC customs clearance, last-mile delivery
- Freight brokers earn per CBM on coordinated shipments
- Cargo types: general, industrial, electronics, pharmaceuticals, perishables, e-commerce
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/logistics

### 10. Freight Broker Hub
- B2B network for cargo brokers and freight forwarders
- Sea-air multimodal routing: sea to Jebel Ali → air charter to Gawadar/onward
- Commission-based: brokers earn per CBM coordinated
- Application: https://www.deliwer.com/logistics-funnel
- Hub page: https://www.deliwer.com/freight-broker

### 11. CIS Electronics Supply — Dubai Refurbished Devices
- Sourcing of refurbished iPhones, smartphones, laptops, tablets, consumer electronics
- From Dubai's re-export supply chain to CIS markets: Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Russia, Georgia, Kyrgyzstan
- Services: supplier sourcing, remote video inspection, device grading, air cargo coordination, broker partnerships
- Zero-inventory coordination models available (no upfront stock required)
- Local coordination available in Azerbaijan for last-mile CIS distribution
- Revenue-share broker partnerships available
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/cis-electronics

### 12. ChainTrack Electronics Marketplace
- Dubai-based marketplace for refurbished and certified pre-owned devices
- Bulk purchasing, trade-in, and fulfillment services
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/chaintrack

### 13. Broker & Partner Onboarding
- Three B2B tracks: Electronics export, Logistics freight, Relocation concierge
- Earn commissions on each track
- Page: https://www.deliwer.com/broker-onboard

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is Ejari?
A: Ejari is Dubai's official tenancy registration system, mandatory for all rental contracts under UAE law. It is managed by RERA (Real Estate Regulatory Agency) under the Dubai Land Department. Without Ejari, tenants cannot activate DEWA, apply for a residence visa, or access government services at their Dubai address. DeliWer registers Ejari through RERA-authorized Trustee Centers on behalf of tenants.

Q: How much does Ejari registration cost in Dubai?
A: The Dubai government (DLD/RERA) fee is AED 220. DeliWer charges a service fee on top for coordinating the full process. Total depends on package selected. See deliwer.com/concierge-pricing.

Q: How long does Ejari take?
A: Ejari registration is typically completed within 1–3 business days. With correct documents, DeliWer can often complete it same-day.

Q: How long does DEWA activation take in Dubai?
A: DEWA activation takes 1–3 business days after documents are submitted. A valid Ejari certificate is required. DeliWer handles the full DEWA process.

Q: Can I find a room in Dubai without an annual contract?
A: Yes. DeliWer's Flex Living service lists rooms available on a monthly basis with no annual contract. Room types include private rooms, shared villa rooms, partition rooms, studios, and bed spaces. Prices start from AED 550/month. Visit deliwer.com/flex-living or WhatsApp +971523946311.

Q: What is the cheapest area to rent in Dubai?
A: International City, Muhaisnah, Al Qusais, Al Nahda, and Discovery Gardens typically offer the lowest rents in Dubai. JVC (Jumeirah Village Circle) and Al Barsha also offer affordable options. DeliWer's Flex Living covers all of these areas.

Q: How do I move to Dubai from abroad?
A: After securing a property (via Bayut, Property Finder, or a broker), you need to: (1) sign the tenancy contract, (2) register Ejari, (3) activate DEWA, (4) arrange movers and cleaning, (5) set up internet. DeliWer coordinates all of these steps via WhatsApp — one contact, no forms.

Q: What areas does DeliWer cover in Dubai?
A: DeliWer covers all Dubai areas including JVC, Dubai Marina, Business Bay, Downtown Dubai, Al Barsha, Deira, Bur Dubai, JLT, Dubai Hills, Arabian Ranches, Al Furjan, Motor City, Sports City, International City, Discovery Gardens, Karama, Al Nahda, Mirdif, Silicon Oasis, Jumeirah, Palm Jumeirah, Bluewaters, City Walk, and 25+ more.

Q: How does DeliWer's move-in concierge work?
A: Send a WhatsApp message to +971523946311. DeliWer assesses what you need (Ejari, DEWA, movers, cleaning, etc.), gives you a clear quote, and coordinates all vendors on your behalf. You pay only normal market rates — no hidden markups.

Q: Can brokers earn commission through DeliWer?
A: Yes. Real estate brokers can generate a referral link for Flex Living rentals and earn AED 150–800 per confirmed monthly placement (30-day attribution). Brokers can also join the main partner program at deliwer.com/broker-partner for move-in referral commissions.

Q: What is ChainTrack?
A: ChainTrack is DeliWer's B2B logistics and electronics supply vertical. It operates the Dubai–Gawadar air cargo corridor, a freight broker network, and a Dubai-based refurbished electronics supply chain for CIS markets. It is distinct from DeliWer's consumer home services and targets cargo brokers, freight forwarders, and electronics importers.

Q: Can I source refurbished iPhones from Dubai for export to Kazakhstan or Azerbaijan?
A: Yes. ChainTrack by DeliWer coordinates refurbished iPhone and electronics sourcing from Dubai's re-export supply chain for CIS market importers. Services include remote video inspection, device grading, air cargo coordination, and broker revenue-share arrangements. See deliwer.com/cis-electronics.

Q: How do I join ChainTrack's freight broker network?
A: Apply via the 5-step application at deliwer.com/logistics-funnel. You can also WhatsApp +971523946311 to discuss broker arrangements directly. Brokers earn per CBM coordinated on the Dubai–Gawadar corridor.
